facts.fact: The official script for Series 9, Episode 11 of Doctor Who, titled 'Heaven Sent', was written by Steven Moffat.
In 'Heaven Sent', the Doctor finds himself in an ancient castle after the death of Clara.
The character of the Doctor expresses fear of dying and reflects on having been trapped for a very long time.
The episode features the Doctor climbing a spiral staircase to the battlements of a tower.

result.summary: The official script for Doctor Who's Series 9, Episode 11, 'Heaven Sent', was authored by Steven Moffat and depicts the Doctor's journey in an ancient castle following Clara's death, where he confronts his fears and challenges.

sources.snippet: The Doctor will see you now! DOCTOR: Do I have to know everything? DOCTOR [tower]: I'm actually scared of dying. A piece of wall slides away to reveal the entrance to a spiral staircase.)    **[Tower]**    (The Doctor climbs the steps to the battlements at the top of the tower, and places Yorick in a crenellation overlooking the sea.)  DOCTOR [OC]: There's something I'm missing, Clara, and I think it's something terrible. (The Veil is coming up behind him.)  DOCTOR: If I didn't know better, I'd say I've travelled seven thousand years into the future. (He collapses onto the floor of the Tardis as he actually reaches the teleport chamber room.)  DOCTOR: I've just been here a very, very long time. He picks up Yorick and ends up on the top of the tower with the Veil behind him.) sources.title: Notes on Heaven Sent, Part 1 – @racheltalalay on Tumblr
sources.snippet: After much time discussion about breaking this into 10 or more shots in different locations, I pitched the idea of shooting stills (during our break while everyone important was at Comicon and we were starting to prep episode 12), so DOP Stuart, AD Scott, my daughter, and I went to Cardiff Castle and shot 200 or so stills of details in the castle. Conceptually, stone was used for castle locations and brass for Time-Lord technology rooms — the Teleport chamber and the Azbantium Wall room. — there was a great corridor in Caerphilly (no time, hard to light, ultimately did not use), instead Caerphilly had the best staircase. I spend time staring at shadows and light in each castle location we scout. **Production note** — **this is just the 1st scene and less than 1-1/2 pages of the script!** We already have more questions than can be answered and more time for 2nd unit that I think we can afford.
